smokeSayLines.line: 🍲 Tashi cooked for the haven — meals stretched. Tashi worked the smoke racks too — 2 batches preserved (~778 kcal, keeps a couple of weeks).

raidSayLines.line: 📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
The dog-shaped silence at the treeline stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
⚔️ Adaeze stood down the dog-shaped silence at the treeline and kept walking — 5 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)
⚔️ Adaeze stared down the dog-shaped silence at the treeline and it backed off — 0 rounds, not a scratch on them. It's still out there, somewhere.
🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Three shapes at the treeline — dog-shaped silences, circling. (A real pack is out there now: 3 of them. No names yet — nobody's lived to argue about one.)
Nino came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A dog-shaped silence at the treeline. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
